data.title: Second reminder: NetzMuster February 2026 invoice
data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH sent a second reminder (2. Mahnung) for the unpaid February 2026 invoice. The total due is €49.99, including a €5.00 reminder fee, to be received by 7 April 2026.
data.explanation: Your internet provider says the February 2026 invoice is still unpaid, despite an earlier payment reminder on 12 March 2026. A reminder fee of €5.00 was added. If payment does not arrive by 7 April 2026, the provider reserves the right to block your connection. Pay the total to the IBAN shown, or if you already paid, the letter says to treat it as settled. If you think the fee or the claim is wrong, contact the provider. Note the letter's date and the deadline are already in the past relative to today's date, so check your account and contact the provider promptly.
